messages:
alex_k: Hey team — trying to redeem promo code 'SUMMER+2025' in the Android app, API returns "invalid_code". Dashboard shows promo active. Can you help?
megan_support: Sorry about that — can you paste exactly what you entered and which app version?
alex_k: Pasted from an email, app v4.2.1. I copied 'SUMMER+2025' and pasted into promo field.
megan_support: Thanks. Can you also share the response body from the /promos/redeem call (if possible)?
alex_k: Here: 
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{"error":"invalid_code","message":"Promo code not found"}
megan_support: Got it. I asked eng to check logs for that account id (acct_01F...). Stand by.
dan_eng: Looking at ingress logs for that timestamp — I see the client submitted code value as 'SUMMER 2025' (space instead of plus). On our redeem path we do a strict equality lookup.
alex_k: huh — I definitely pasted a plus. Could Android keyboard be turning + into a space?
megan_support: Some keyboards interpret + differently or email clients encode + as space when copying. Do you remember copying from Gmail or another app?
alex_k: Yes copied from Gmail mobile.
megan_support: Ok — I'll issue a manual credit now for $50 and extend the trial 7 days while we fix.
megan_support: Issued manual credit to acct_01F... ($50). Trial extended +7 days. Ticket: CS-6421. :white_check_mark:
nina_ops: Thanks for the quick workaround. For root cause: our promo lookup uses raw code string. If incoming payload has spaces where a '+' exists (common with URL decoding and some paste flows), we treat it as different.
dan_eng: I'm going to add normalization to the redeem endpoint to treat sequences where '+' <-> ' ' if the promo exists only when swapped. Quick patch to run in canary today.
deploy-bot: deploy-service: rollout started for service promo-redeemer v2.14.1-canary by dan_eng — status: in-progress
dan_eng: Patch will: 1) normalize common whitespace vs plus artifacts for the matching step, 2) log if normalization was applied so we can audit. Will not auto-correct dashboard entries.
megan_support: Practical note for support: if a user reports a code that contains special chars (+, /, =) and redeem fails, try a paste with the keyboard's plain-text mode or ask them to manually type the symbols.
alex_k: ty everyone — appreciate the manual credit and fix plan. Happy to test the canary later.
deploy-bot: deploy-service: rollout completed for promo-redeemer v2.14.1-canary — status: success
dan_eng: Can confirm canary handled both 'SUMMER+2025' and 'SUMMER 2025' by normalization and returned the expected success payload. Plan to promote to prod in 2 hours after monitoring.
megan_support: Closing loop with the customer now. Will update CS-6421 with logs and remediation steps. :memo:
